physical_subject: How does changing only the air volume change a bottle resonance?
relationship: With fixed effective neck geometry, Helmholtz resonance frequency is proportional to inverse square root of cavity air volume.
operation: Keep a neck visible while cavity air volume becomes one quarter; hear and see a doubled modeled frequency.
closest_prior: quiet/02-oscillator: spring-circle rhythm; material/05-springs: connection stiffness
substantive_difference: New compressible cavity and neck-inertia mechanism with inverse-root air-volume scaling; not projection or spring wiring.
